inputs.text: This is exactly how they manufacture consent: turn one arrest into a “sanctuary versus public safety” scare, then present expanded federal power as the only answer. DHS’s framing and the missing fuller picture are not incidental—they work together to make harsher enforcement seem inevitable while hiding who benefits. The public-safety language is cover, not an honest explanation.
